Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.ml.dataset.model

Class ActionVector

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.ml.dataset.model.ActionVector
public class ActionVector extends Object
Represents an action as a numerical vector for machine learning applications.

ActionVector translates ActionConfig into a fixed-size numeric vector suitable for neural networks and other ML algorithms. The vector uses the short data type (-32,768 to 32,767) to accommodate both categorical and continuous values.

Data encoding strategy:

  • Categorical values (e.g., action types) are encoded as discrete integers
  • Coordinate values (x, y, width, height) are stored directly as shorts
  • Continuous values (time, similarity scores) are multiplied by 1000 to preserve three decimal places of precision

The vector size is fixed at 100 elements to provide space for various action parameters while maintaining consistency across different action types.
